snippet: Web Development at Launch Craft: custom responsive websites, landing pages, e-commerce (Shopify/WooCommerce) and web apps. Fast, SEO-ready, mobile-first. Pricing discussed on call.
App Development at Launch Craft: Android, iOS and cross-platform apps (Flutter/React Native). From MVP to Play Store launch.
Brand Marketing at Launch Craft: Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube growth and full Instagram handling (content + ads + DM). We handle strategy, creatives and daily optimization.
AI Automation at Launch Craft: chatbots, workflow automation and custom AI tools that save hours daily. Built around your existing tools.
Voice Agents at Launch Craft: like me — automated WhatsApp calling that answers, qualifies and books meetings 24/7. Same tech as this bot.
Our process: 1) quick discovery call, 2) proposal, 3) build, 4) launch and support. Timelines depend on scope — discussed on the call.
Pricing at Launch Craft is custom by scope. We share a clear quote after the discovery call — no hidden fees. Tell us your service and budget and we'll propose a plan.
Launch Craft has delivered projects across industries — from startups to established brands. Our team can share relevant examples on the discovery call.
Launch Craft is a full-service digital agency with specialists in development, marketing and AI. Our team handles everything from strategy to execution.
Launch Craft operates remotely and serves clients globally. We connect via WhatsApp, video calls and email — wherever you are.
For support, our team is available via WhatsApp and email. We provide ongoing maintenance and support after launch.
We'd love to schedule a quick call to discuss your needs. Just share your name and a convenient time, and our team will reach out.
